messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased 5xx and timeouts observed for model-serve-prod cluster. 5xx delta ~+15% over 15m. Paging oncall @alice_oncall. Metrics: https://telemetry.redwood.ai/d/serve/prod-5xx

alice_oncall: acknowledged, pulling dashboards now. which pool/region showing errors?

emma_telemetry: us-west-2 / pool: prod-2 is noisy. error types: ~60% segfaults in model-runner, ~25% OOMs during allocation, rest gateway 502/504. spike start ~00:42 UTC. trace link: https://telemetry.redwood.ai/d/serve/prod-5xx?from=1749876000&to=1749877200

bob_sre: I see a deploy for quant-attn v0.9.1 at 00:38 UTC to prod-2 (rollout id r-2026-07-15-3). possible regression. recommend immediate traffic steering away from prod-2.

carol_runtime: grabbing logs + core dumps. quick grep shows repeated `free()` after failed alloc in libquant_attn.so. sample stack: `quant_attn::alloc_cache -> attention_kernel::forward -> runner::handle_request`. attaching snippet shortly.

frank_engineer: if quant kernel is culprit, we should either rollback or enable kernel fallback to scalar-attn. Which is faster?

alice_oncall: plan: 1) route new requests away from prod-2 to prod-1 and legacy cluster, 2) apply quick config guard to limit max_seq on prod-2, 3) restart runners in prod-2, 4) rollback quant-attn if crashes persist. bob, can you apply routing?

bob_sre: routing change in progress: `routerctl set-pool-weight prod-2=0 --fallback=legacy` then `routerctl refresh`. also bumping prod-1 capacity: `fleet scale --pool=prod-1 --add 6`.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-2026-07-15-3 deployed by carol_runtime at 00:38 UTC. Component: quant-attn-plugin v0.9.1.

carol_runtime: paste of short backtrace:
``` 
#0  0x7f4d8a1b in quant_attn::alloc_cache (/opt/lib/libquant_attn.so)
#1  0x55b1d2 in attention_forward (model_runner)
#2  0x60a9f4 in model_runner::process_request
#3  0x7f3b2c00 in start_thread
```
Looks like allocation fails during high seq-length requests, then a subsequent free touches invalid pointer -> segfault.

dave_custops: CS: received multiple tickets for timeouts/502s (customers C-1122, C-441). Logged and notifying. Recommend status page if mitigation not within 10m.

frank_engineer: quick mitigation: add a max_sequence override in prod-2 config to 2048 and disable large-batch path. path: `/etc/serve/pools/prod-2/config.yaml`. I can apply now.

alice_oncall: please apply and then restart runners gracefully. keep me posted.

frank_engineer: running: `configctl set prod-2 max_seq=2048 && configctl set prod-2 enable_large_batch=false && configctl reload prod-2`

emma_telemetry: config change applied. traffic successfully shifted, error rate on prod-2 fell ~45% within 3 minutes. overall 5xx reduced to +6% over baseline.

bob_sre: initiating rolling restart of prod-2 runners with graceful drain: `runnersctl restart --pool prod-2 --rolling --batch 5 --grace 20s`.

deploy-bot: Rollback available: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-runner --to-revision=12` (pre-quant). Manual confirmation required.

alice_oncall: approve rollback if restarts don't clear segfaults. carol, can you run smoke tests post-rollback?

carol_runtime: will run smoke suite. meanwhile, I collected core dumps and uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-dumps/incident-1749876543/. Creating ISSUE-8972 for root-cause.

dave_custops: sent interim customer message: "We're routing traffic and scaling to mitigate elevated errors. Engineers are investigating a runtime crash impacting some requests. We'll follow up within 30 minutes."

emma_telemetry: after restart + config clamp, segfault rate on prod-2 dropped to near-zero. but OOMs still sporadic for very long-seq requests routed to legacy cluster. overall 5xx now +2% baseline.

frank_engineer: smoke tests after new pods pass for standard workloads. no segfaults in short-run. looks like the quant-attn edge case hits only long-sequence > 4k with KV priming.

bob_sre: holding rollback for now since clamp+restart mitigated immediate crash. I'll add deploy guard requiring canary long-seq perf test before re-enabling quant plugin.

alice_oncall: status: mitigated at 00:59 UTC. keep fallback routes for 30m, monitor for 1h. action items: carol_runtime to debug double-free/fail path, frank_engineer to add max_seq safety limit and telemetry alert, bob_sre to add deploy gating, dave_custops to prepare public post-incident update.

carol_runtime: created repro harness and attached core dump + steps in ISSUE-8972. suspect memory reuse after failed allocation in quant_attn allocator.

dave_custops: posting status update: "Mitigation applied; traffic rerouted and runners restarted. We observed brief customer-facing 502s/timeouts. No evidence of data loss. Full postmortem will be posted in ~3 hours."

bob_sre: scheduling hotfix window to add allocator checks and disable risky path by default. will coordinate with carol and frank.

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated by alice_oncall at 1749877143. Tags: runtime-segfault, oom, routing-mitigation, deploy-gate.

alice_oncall: closing the loop: postmortem draft in #postmortems and confluence ticket: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incident/ISSUE-8972. On-call watch continues for 60m. Thanks all.
